# rsImageToCurve · Convert image to curve

> Module: Geometry / Curves

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: The vector curve (PolylineCurve) generated by the bitmap according to the selected tracking mode is written to the layer RsTool_ImageToCurve

**Run**: Enter `rsImageToCurve` in the Rhino command line (opens a settings window).

**Workflow**:

1. Command line input rsImageToCurve
2. Click "Select Image" to select a bitmap (PNG/JPG/JPEG/BMP)
3. Adjust parameters such as tracking mode/threshold/noise/smoothing/optimization (viewport real-time yellow preview)
4. Set the target width and whether to include edges
5. Click "Generate" and specify the lower left corner insertion point (press Enter to use the world origin)

**Parameters**:

| Display name | Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tracking mode | TraceMode | list | Threshold mask | Threshold Mask/Color Border/VTracer Outline | 0=Threshold mask,1=Color edges,2=VTracer contours |
| Threshold/sensitivity | Threshold | double | 19 | 0-100 (%) | Foreground grayscale threshold in grayscale/VTracer mode; color difference sensitivity in color boundary mode |
| Noise filter | Speckles | double | 2 | 0-100 | Filter small area noise (0-100). The larger the value, the more fine areas will be ignored. |
| Smooth corners | SmoothCorners | double | 1.0 | 0.00-1.34 | Corner smoothing strength, the larger the value, the smoother the corner. |
| Optimize | Optimize | double | 0.20 | 0.00-1.00 | The degree of curve simplification. The larger the value, the fewer control points. |
| reverse color | Invert | toggle | false |  | Invert foreground/background selection |
| Contains edges | IncludeBorder | toggle | true |  | Whether to retain contours that adhere to the edges of the image |
| target width | TargetWidth | double | 100.0 | 0.001-1000000.0 | Target width of generated curves in Rhino (model units) |

**Notes**: The "Help" button in the window only pops up the copyright statement and no external help URL; the yellow curve is only a viewport preview. Click OK and specify the insertion point before writing the document.
